title: "rungar scale-sets ls"
description: "List the configured scale sets, and those found only by their runners"
---

List the configured scale sets, and those no longer configured whose runners are still on the fleet. GitHub cannot be asked for every scale set it has, so one that is neither configured nor has a runner is not listed; inspect and rm still find it by name.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar scale-sets ls [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Write JSON. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
